moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-scatter-assemble, written here): Split chars; each starts at a seeded random offset x ±200 %, y ±150 % of its glyph box (demo ±2.6 em / ±1.6 em, kept inside the frame) and moves home over 1 s power1.inOut; random order, 50 ms apart (demo 70 ms capped 0.7 s), from 0.3 s; demo opacity 0.3 → 1. Loop exit: scatter back, 0.55 s, random order 30 ms apart, from 2.55 s; loop 3.4 s. Params: spreadX / spreadY: độ tản (200 % / 150 %) · duration (1 s) · stagger: ngẫu nhiên (0.05 s) · seed.
